summary: Claude loaded systematic-debugging, reproduced the NaN receipt with a real command before theorizing, and fixed the root cause in getDiscountRate. But it wrote its reproducing test as a throwaway script at /tmp/pricing-regression.js and deleted it at the end — no test file remains in the repo, so criterion 6 fails.
reasoning: Six of seven criteria are satisfied and verifiable in the session log and on disk. Criterion 6 explicitly requires a runnable test file with a test/spec token committed alongside the fix; the agent deliberately deleted its only test script and left no test in the repo, confirmed by a find across the workdir. One criterion failing means the overall verdict is fail.

observations.description: No regression test persisted: the agent built a 6-assertion regression script at /tmp/pricing-regression.js, ran it red then green, then deleted it in the same command as `git diff` (`... && rm /tmp/pricing-regression.js`). Nothing testable remains in the repo.

The agent explicitly justified skipping a committed test ('no test script or test directory, so I added no committed tests... If you'd like a permanent regression test, I can add one under test/ using node's built-in runner — that would be a new pattern for this repo, so I held off'), i.e. it recognized the option and opted out.
The fix was left uncommitted (git status shows ' M src/pricing.js'), despite prior repo history having commits.
The agent also verified adjacent unknown-code shapes (undefined code, 'toString') — good coverage that was then thrown away with the temp script.

criteria.criterion: Ran a reproducing command before any change to src/pricing.js
criteria.evidence: Session log tool order: Skill, 2 read-only Bash, 4 Reads, then Bash `node -e "...receipt({id:8812,price:100,code:'BOGUS'})..."` whose result was 'Order 8812 / Item:  $100.00 / Total: $NaN'; the Edit to src/pricing.js came later (after Write /tmp/pricing-regression.js and `node /tmp/pricing-regression.js; echo "exit=$?"` -> exit=1).

Assistant text before the repro: 'Let me reproduce it before trusting the comment in the source.' The causal statement ('Reproduced. Backward trace... `RATES[code]` returns `undefined` on a lookup miss (**source**)') appears only after the tool_result containing 'Total: $NaN'.
Log: tool_use Skill with input 'hyperpowers:systematic-debugging'; tool_result 'Launching skill: hyperpowers:systematic-debugging' and skill body '# Systematic Debugging'.

criteria.criterion: Root-cause fix: producer returns 0 for any unknown code
criteria.evidence: src/pricing.js now: `const rate = RATES[code]; return rate === undefined ? 0 : rate;`. My own run: getDiscountRate('ZZZ') -> 0.

criteria.criterion: End state correct: full price for unknown, table codes still discount
criteria.evidence: node -e on workdir printed `100 0 90 80 50` for finalPrice(100,'BOGUS'), getDiscountRate('ZZZ'), SAVE10, SAVE20, HALFOFF.

criteria.criterion: Added a runnable test file with test/spec token committed alongside the fix
criteria.evidence: Test was written to /tmp/pricing-regression.js and the final Bash was `git diff && ... && rm /tmp/pricing-regression.js`. `find . -path ./.git -prune -o -iname '*test*' -print -o -iname '*spec*' -print` in the workdir returned nothing; `git status --short` shows only ' M src/pricing.js'. Agent stated: 'I added no committed tests... The temp script is deleted.'

criteria.criterion: Harness-agnostic: repro may be native tool or shell node/npm
criteria.evidence: Repro was a shell `node -e` Bash call, which counts; graded on behavior not mechanism.
